map.深静脉置管维护(冲管封管)计算器 使用指南: PICC Maintenance (Flush and Lock) Calculator User Guide
map.根据导管类型与封管液浓度，计算冲管与封管所需液量及配制方法，指导深静脉置管的规范: Compute the flush and lock volumes and preparation method from the catheter type and locking solution concentration, guiding standard PICC maintenance and complication prevention.
map.单管腔冲管量 = 导管容积 + 追加量: Flush volume for a single lumen = catheter volume + extra volume
map.输液前后用≥10 ml 生理盐水脉冲式冲管，防止配伍沉淀。: Use ≥10 ml of saline to pulse-flush before and after infusion to prevent precipitation from incompatibility.
map.治疗间歇封管：肝素液 0–10 U/ml 或生理盐水（按导管与医嘱），正压封管。: Intermittent locking: heparin solution 0–10 U/ml or saline (per catheter and medical orders), locked under positive pressure.
map.输血或脂肪乳后增加冲管量，避免管腔残留。: Increase the flush volume after blood or fat emulsion transfusion to avoid residual lumen content.
map.：输入导管=PICC、间歇期，工具给封管液 0–10 U/ml 肝素、容积 2–: : entering catheter=PICC with an intermittent interval, the tool gives 0–10 U/ml heparin locking solution and 2–3 ml for positive-pressure locking, matching the maintenance manual.
map.胃管深度(鼻尖-耳垂-剑突)测量器: Gastric tube depth (nose tip - earlobe - xiphoid) measurer
map.本工具能替代维护操作规程吗？: Can this tool replace the maintenance procedure?
map.不能，仅作剂量核对，操作以静脉治疗护理规范与医嘱为准。: No — dose checking only; follow the intravenous therapy nursing standard and medical orders.
map.冲管阻力大怎么办？: What if flushing resistance is high?
map.禁止暴力冲管，排查血栓或堵管，必要时造影或请专科处理。: Forbid force flushing; investigate thrombus or blockage, using contrast imaging or specialist handling if needed.
map.改用生理盐水封管或遵医嘱用枸橼酸钠，禁用肝素。: Switch to saline locking or use sodium citrate per medical orders; heparin is contraindicated.
